activation_dynamics.note: MuJoCo muscle activation dynamics scale the time constants with activation level (see MuJoCo docs, muscle actuators); values here are measured, not modelled by BioHand.

isolated_activation.protocol: u_a=1 for 0.2 s from qpos0, gravity off; dq = q - q(all u=0); expected sign = sign(r) at qpos0 for joints with |r| >= 1 mm; joints whose expected motion pushes into a limit at qpos0 are marked blocked and excluded from agreement

ablation.method: actuator removed by zeroing its gear on a model copy (no active or passive force); 1 s simulation from qpos0; differences vs intact model

tasks.finger_flexors_0p5: FDS2-5 and FDP2-5 at u=0.5, others 0
